mapper.sql: id, skill_id, version, package_url, manifest_url, changelog, status, is_latest, is_rollback, rolled_back_from, skill_name_snapshot, skill_description_snapshot, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_version (skill_id, version, package_url, manifest_url, changelog, status, is_latest, is_rollback, rolled_back_from, skill_name_snapshot, skill_description_snapshot, created_at) VALUES (#{skillId}, #{version}, #{packageUrl}, #{manifestUrl}, #{changelog}, #{status}, #{latest}, #{rollback}, #{rolledBackFrom}, #{skillNameSnapshot}, #{skillDescriptionSnapshot}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_version SET package_url = #{packageUrl}, manifest_url = #{manifestUrl}, changelog = #{changelog}, status = #{status}, is_latest = #{latest}, is_rollback = #{rollback}, rolled_back_from = #{rolledBackFrom}, skill_name_snapshot = #{skillNameSnapshot}, skill_description_snapshot = #{skillDescriptionSnapshot} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_version WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT FROM skill_version WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM skill_version WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_version SET is_latest = false WHERE skill_id = #{skillId}
